title: docs: fix stale CHANGELOG and supersede ADR-0004
description:
The CHANGELOG and ADR-0004 describe a gossipsub topology and DHT discovery fallback that were removed in commit bcd4026. Any new contributor reading the docs gets a false picture of the architecture. Documentation that contradicts the running code is worse than no documentation.

What needs to be done:
1. Rewrite the [Unreleased] CHANGELOG block to reflect current architecture: IHAVE/TAKETHIS TCP peering, Kubo HTTP RPC for IPFS, ActivityPub, JMAP, IMAP4rev2, SMTP, secretx.
2. Supersede ADR-0004 (gossipsub-per-hierarchy) with a new ADR documenting the TCP peering decision and why gossipsub was dropped.
3. Audit ADR-0005 through ADR-0007 for accuracy; add missing ADRs for decisions made since ADR-0007 (ActivityPub, JMAP, IMAP4rev2, sieve-native boundary, secretx).
